failures.evidence: We see a tendency of the T1 events to occur in small clusters

failures.evidence: the droplets are compressed into quasi-two-dimensional pancakes
failures.reason: (b) slot_binding FAIL: 源文II.A节明确 'the droplets are compressed into pancake shapes' — pancake是单个液滴被压成的形状, 不是由多个droplets组成的整体; 单droplet→pancake是形状变换(同一实体), 不是part-whole组成关系, whole/component两槽都绑错。

failures.nodes: source=Jammed materials; target=applied stress; effect=elastic solids; effect=liquid
failures.evidence: Jammed materials behave like elastic solids for low applied stresses but flow like a liquid when the applied stress is above the yield stress
failures.reason: (c) polarity/direction FAIL: 句子说的是applied stress的大小决定jammed materials表现为elastic solid还是liquid — stress是条件/原因, 材料行为是结果; 边却把Jammed materials绑为source、applied stress绑为target, 主影响方向放反了。

failures.nodes: source=small subset of particles; target=most of the load
failures.evidence: only a small subset of particles support most of the load
failures.reason: (a) relation_exists FAIL: 句子陈述的是一小部分颗粒承载(support)大部分载荷, 是load-bearing的结构性事实; 两实体之间没有被陈述的影响/依赖关系, influences是模式误配。

failures.nodes: from=plasticity of soft materials; to=localized plastic events

failures.reason: (b) slot_binding FAIL: 句子把T1 events与large deformation fluctuations相连, target应绑deformation fluctuations; fragile stress network不在本句, 误绑为target。

failures.reason: (a) relation_exists FAIL: 句子陈述两者之间存在connection(相关/伴随关系), 不是两者相似; connection≠similarity, 关系类型绑错。
